articles.title: Payward plans to offer U.S. clients onchain perpetual futures on Hyperliquid
articles.snippet: Leveraging its $550 million acquisition of Bitnomial, Payward aims to become the first registered U.S. exchange to deploy markets on the Hyperliquid protocol.

articles.title: Ethereum, Base give up on common wallet standard after months of talks
articles.snippet: Ethereum is moving ahead with EIP-8141 while Coinbase-backed Base backs EIP-8130, leaving wallets and apps that span both networks facing different transaction systems.

articles.title: Stablecoin growth could boost dollar dominance, US Treasury demand: BoE official
articles.snippet: A Bank of England policy maker said digital dollars could expand access to the US currency while turning stablecoin issuers into bigger buyers of government debt.

articles.title: Binance adds 11 US-listed ETFs to wealth management offering
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange is expanding its traditional finance offerings with 11 US-listed exchange-traded funds focused on US Treasurys and investment-grade bonds.

articles.title: Ethereum, Base wallet standards talks fail, Ethlabs researcher says
articles.snippet: Ethereum and Base are pursuing different account abstraction designs after talks failed, according to Ethlabs researcher Derek Chiang.
